svg.title: The rose r = 3 sin(2θ) with one petal shaded
svg.desc: A polar grid with circles of radius 1, 2 and 3. The four-petal rose r = 3 sin(2θ) is drawn in emerald. The petal in the first quadrant, swept as θ runs from 0 to π/2, is shaded; it starts and ends at the pole, where r = 0, and reaches its tip, r = 3, at θ = π/4.
